label: texture

label: voronoi texture

evidence: A Voronoi Texture node is in the node editor, and the header reads "Auto-offset direction: right" with node-transform hints (Confirm, Cancel, Node Attachment) in the status bar, so the node is being moved with the pointer.

label: empty spot
